parent_tips.before_reading: Preview 'The First Star' together. Ask: What do you think Owl will do? Look for short vowel words like: star, dark, far, car, park.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out tricky words. Notice the short vowel pattern in words like star, dark, far, car, park. Encourage expression when reading!
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What happened when Owl got into trouble? What happened at the end? What was your favorite part about the the story?
